title: Vietnam Legal Compliance Review
description: Structured machine-readable legal and regulatory compliance assessment covering Vietnamese corporate governance, commercial contracts, labor relations, intellectual property, cybersecurity, and Decree 13/2023/ND-CP personal data protection.

entity.description: Legal entity name under Vietnamese law

reviewer.description: Reviewer name, role, or counsel title

statutory_basis.description: Governing statutory provisions, laws, or decrees

finding.description: Factual non-compliance or contractual ambiguity finding

impact.description: Legal, operational, or financial liability impact

mitigation.description: Recommended legal mitigation or contractual redline

status.description: Resolution status of the risk item

risk_matrix.description: Array of evaluated statutory risk findings

law.description: Name and official code of the governing law or decree

relevance.description: Relevance summary to the matter under review

statutory_citations.description: Official legal authorities and gazette citations

recommendations.description: Actionable legal recommendations and remedial steps

required.description: Whether human approval is mandatory prior to execution

approved.description: Whether approval has been formally granted

approver.description: Designated human approver role or name

approver_role.description: Title of designated corporate or legal authority

risk_matrix.finding: Master Service Agreement Section 11.2 imposes a 20% contract penalty for delayed milestone delivery
risk_matrix.impact: Exceeds the statutory ceiling of 8% on the breached obligation portion; clause is void and unenforceable under Vietnamese law
risk_matrix.mitigation: Redline penalty clause to strictly 8% of the delayed milestone value and stipulate separate actual damages compensation under Article 302

risk_matrix.finding: Customer PII is transmitted to overseas AWS Singapore region without completed DPIA Form 04 and Form 06 notification to A05 MPS
risk_matrix.impact: Administrative fines up to 5% total revenue under draft PDP sanction decree and risk of operational suspension
risk_matrix.mitigation: Conduct Data Processing Impact Assessment (DPIA), execute cross-border transfer assessment dossier, and submit notification to A05 MPS within statutory 60-day window

risk_matrix.finding: Cloud infrastructure procurement contract with affiliated entity exceeds 35% of total asset value without General Meeting of Shareholders resolution
risk_matrix.impact: Contract may be declared null and void; signatories bear joint personal liability for resulting damages
risk_matrix.mitigation: Convene Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders to pass formal approval resolution with interested shareholder recusal

statutory_citations.relevance: Mandatory 8% ceiling on contractual penalties for breach of commercial obligations
Mandatory Data Processing Impact Assessment (DPIA) dossier preparation and retention
Outbound cross-border transfer impact assessment and filing with Department of Cybersecurity and Hi-tech Crime Prevention (A05 MPS)

statutory_citations.law: Law on Enterprises 2020 (Law No. 59/2020/QH14 as amended 2022)
statutory_citations.relevance: Approval authority and disclosure requirements for related-party commercial contracts

recommendations: Amend MSA Section 11.2 to cap contractual penalty at 8% of breached obligation value per Article 301 Commercial Law 2005
Complete and file Decree 13/2023/ND-CP Article 25 cross-border data transfer dossier with A05 MPS prior to production rollout
Obtain General Meeting of Shareholders approval resolution for affiliated procurement transactions exceeding 35% asset threshold
Enforce human approval gate before executing commercial agreements or external regulatory filings

human_approval_gate.comments: Pending redline acceptance from counterparty on Article 301 penalty cap

examples.disclaimer: This legal compliance review is prepared for internal enterprise governance and risk mitigation purposes. It does not constitute formal representation in judicial proceedings, attorney-client advocacy before courts, or authorized execution of filings.
